2609.03527.title: NeoRed: A Knowledge-Logic-Alignment Multimodal Large Language Model for Neonatal Respiratory Disease Diagnosis
2609.03527.paper_summary: Neonatal respiratory diseases are a major cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality, posing substantial challenges in clinical practice. Despite recent advances, existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face two key limitations in neonatal diagnosis: (1) domain gap arising from predominantly adult training data; (2) insufficient integration of multidimensional clinical context for accurate diagnosis. To address these challenges, we collect two real-world clinical datasets (NeoCXR and NeoCXR-EV) and propose NeoRed, to the best of our knowledge, the first MLLM tailored for neonatal respiratory disease, filling the gap in neonatal diagnostic reports generation. To enhance joint diagnosis from heterogeneous clinical context and chest X-rays, we design a novel Knowledge-Logic-Alignment (KLA) framework which constrains model behavior from three perspectives: 1) Knowledge Prior Injection (KPI) incorporates neonatologist-inspired diagnostic priors into multimodal representations, guiding disease-specific attention across modalities; 2) Diagnostic Logic Constraint (DLC) aligns the semantics of generated reports with multimodal diagnostic logic; and 3) Visual Semantic Alignment (VSA) establishes semantic correspondence between visual features and imaging conclusions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeoRed enables accurate neonatal diagnostic reports generation, achieving ROUGE-L of 53.29% and Clinical Efficacy F1 score of 65.19% on NeoCXR, outperforming existing MLLMs. NeoRed also preserves competitive report generation performance on adult benchmarks (MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray). Datasets will be available upon application.
2609.03527.paper_summary_zh: 新生兒呼吸疾病是新生兒發病率和死亡率的主要原因，對臨床實踐造成了重大挑戰。儘管最近取得了一些進展，現有的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在新生兒診斷方面面臨兩個主要限制：（1）由於主要基於成人訓練數據而產生的領域差距；（2）對於準確診斷，多維臨床背景的整合不足。為了應對這些挑戰，我們收集了兩個真實世界的臨床數據集（NeoCXR和NeoCXR-EV），並提出了NeoRed，據我們所知，這是第一個專為新生兒呼吸疾病量身定制的MLLM，填補了新生兒診斷報告生成的空白。為了增強來自異質臨床背景和胸部X光片的聯合診斷，我們設計了一個新穎的知識-邏輯-對齊（KLA）框架，從三個角度約束模型行為：1）知識先驗注入（KPI）將新生兒科醫生啟發的診斷先驗納入多模態表示中，引導跨模態的疾病特異性注意力；2）診斷邏輯約束（DLC）使生成報告的語義與多模態診斷邏輯對齊；3）視覺語義對齊（VSA）建立視覺特徵與影像結論之間的語義對應。大量實驗表明，NeoRed能夠生成準確的新生兒診斷報告，在NeoCXR上達到53.29%的ROUGE-L和65.19%的臨床效能F1分數，超越了現有的MLLMs。NeoRed在成人基準（MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray）上也保持了競爭性的報告生成性能。數據集將在申請後提供。
